en: And that's already all.
That's how simple and easy and
straightforward it is to build a single page
application with HTMX.
Now, of course, you still have a backend
here. And of course, it's still that backend
that produces all the HTML code.
You don't have a client-side only single
page application as you might have it with
React or Angular. That is really important.
But you still give your users that
single-page application-like feeling where
everything happens instantly and they never
leave the current page.
Of course, it's up to you whether you need
that for your application, if that's
important for you, but it is something you
can easily build with HTMX, as you can tell.
And therefore, it's important to also know
about this feature.
